Subject: Acme Health — SOC 2 & Compliance Postcall Recap and Next Steps

Hi Jake / Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the compliance items we discussed so we have alignment on next steps. Please let me know if I missed anything.

Primary pain points you shared:
- Need evidence of SOC 2 controls and recent pen test results for the platform we will integrate with.
- Audit log retention and access controls: regulatory requirement for 7 years retention and field-level auditability.
- Data residency & DPA: must support a company-specific DPA and KMS integration for customer-managed keys.
- Incident response and breach notification SLA requirements for PHI/PII exposures.

Goals we heard:
- Get a SOC 2 package and pen test summary for the security review by next week.
- Confirm retention/archival options and a playbook for producing audit logs for your internal compliance team.
- Execute DPA and agree on minimal technical controls to satisfy Acme Health procurement.

What we can provide (next steps / owners / target dates):
1) SOC 2 package + SOC auditor letter — Owner: Marissa Cole — ETA: 2026-11-23
   - Attachment: SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (attached)
2) Pen test executive summary + findings — Owner: Nikhil Sharma — ETA: 2026-11-23
   - Attachment: PenTest_Summary.zip (attached, redacted findings; full report available under NDA)
3) DPA signature request and redline — Owner: Legal (copied) / Marissa to coordinate — ETA: 2026-11-24
   - Attachment: DPA_Signature_Request.pdf (attached)
4) Audit log retention doc + sample export query / format — Owner: Stephanie Nguyen — ETA: 2026-11-25
5) Follow-up compliance call (30 min) to review artifacts & outstanding asks — Owner: Marissa — Proposed times: Tue 2026-11-24 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 2026-11-25 09:00-09:30 PT

Temporary notes on sensitive items:
- Full pen test report contains redacted customer data in logs; we will share only the executive summary publicly and can provide the full report under an NDA if required.
- For KMS/customer-managed keys, we support AWS KMS and customer key rotation; we'll include a short architecture diagram in Stephanie's doc.

Attachments included with this thread:
- SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (PDF, 3.1 MB)
- PenTest_Summary.zip (ZIP, 6.8 MB)
- DPA_Signature_Request.pdf (PDF, 0.2 MB)

Thanks again — I booked a tentative follow-up slot for Tue 11/24 10:00 PT; happy to adjust based on your availability.

Best,

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful and aligned with what we discussed. A couple of quick clarifying questions before we schedule the follow-up call:

1) For the pen test full report — can you confirm whether the full unredacted report requires an NDA? If so, who at Acme should sign and is there a standard NDA we should use?

2) On audit logs: can you confirm the retention mechanics? We need immutable logs for 7 years and the ability to export them in a CSV/JSON format on demand. Is that available out of the box or is it a custom export?

3) DPA: can you confirm whether Redwood supports the customer-managed key requirement in the DPA? The procurement team will insist on the ability to manage keys via AWS KMS or equivalent.

If you can confirm the above before the call that would help move procurement quicker. We can take Tue 11/24 10:00 PT if you’re still available.

Appreciate it —
Jake

Hi Jake — thanks for the questions, good ones. Answers below and next steps.

1) Full pen test report and NDA
- Yes: the full, unredacted pen test is shared under NDA. We can provide our standard mutual NDA; if Acme prefers to use your NDA we can review that too. Nikhil will send the NDA + instructions today and can provision the full report after the NDA is executed.

2) Audit logs and retention
- We support immutable append-only logs with configurable retention policies. For your requirement (7 years) we can keep logs in our secure object store with WORM-like retention. Exports: Stephanie will attach a sample export (CSV and JSON) and a short guide for running ad-hoc exports.

3) Customer-managed keys (CMK)
- We support customer KMS in our Private deployment and for Dedicated customers. For Hosted API customers we offer envelope encryption with customer-managed keys via AWS KMS (bring-your-own-key). The DPA attachment notes the sections for KMS — legal can confirm specific language if you have required wording.

Actions we’ll take now:
- Nikhil: send NDA and high-level pen test sharing process (ETA: today)
- Marissa: upload SOC 2 package to the shared secure link and send DocuSign DPA for signature (ETA: today)
- Stephanie: attach audit-log sample export and brief runbook (ETA: 2026-11-25)
- Follow-up call remains Tue 11/24 10:00 PT (confirming scheduled invite).

Secure artifacts will be uploaded to a restricted link — you’ll get access once NDA is complete. I’ve included DocuSign and HubSpot links below for reference.

DocuSign (DPA): https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/placeholder-acme-dpa
